adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the diff adds an unconditional refresh-token `fetch("https://login.salesforce.com/services/oauth2/token", ...)` and then immediately persists the refreshed access token via `prisma.credential.update(...)` before creating the `jsforce.Connection`. There is no check of `credentialKey` expiry/age before doing the network call + DB write, so any code path that instantiates/initializes this service will always incur an extra round-trip and write, increasing latency and potentially contributing to provider rate limits. This is a real, diff-grounded concern, but not a guaranteed correctness defect by itself.
